terminals.name: gateway
terminals.description: GPT-Pro Cloud gateway (panel, login, account picker, team management) on http://localhost:8080. Uses the AUTH_PASSWORD secret when set, otherwise a dev fallback. The KasmVNC desktop containers require Docker + a manual ChatGPT login and are not started here.
terminals.command: AUTH_PASSWORD="${AUTH_PASSWORD:-devpass}" AUTH_USER="${AUTH_USER:-admin}" PORT=8080 INSTANCES="${INSTANCES:-a,b}" USERS_FILE=/workspace/data-panel/users.json node gateway/server.mjs
